thesis: The speakers describe the founding and evolution of Arctos Sports Partners, a private equity firm led by Doc O'Connor and Ian Charles that focuses on acquiring minority stakes in professional sports franchises. Doc O'Connor details his 32-year career at Creative Artists Agency, where he built the sports division before moving to MSG, while Ian Charles explains his background in secondary advisory and data science tools before co-founding Arctos.
